entries.risk: A broader exception could conceal executable URL or raw HTML sinks; only this exact rule, location, source and message are admitted.
entries.reason: The reported DOM flow is a fragment beginning with # assigned through the fixed href attribute with setAttribute, not parsed as HTML. Other navigation URLs remain subject to createSafeExternalHref.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when CodeQL models literal fixed-name href attribute assignment or this exact fragment projection changes.
entries.targetAction: Retain the exact reviewed behavior and deterministic proof; any source, location or message drift requires renewed classification.

entries.risk: Removing identity protection could duplicate presentation commits after a superseded retry completes.
entries.reason: The retry is awaited immediately before finally. The reported comparison intentionally compares the currently registered Promise with the completed Promise by object identity so an old completion cannot clear a newer pending retry. Awaiting the operand would compare Promise with void and break cleanup. Deterministic dispose/reactivate overlap and subsequent retry tests prove deduplication and release.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when CodeQL distinguishes Promise identity comparison from value comparison or this exact retry cleanup changes.
entries.targetAction: Retain the exact reviewed behavior and deterministic proof; any source, location or message drift requires renewed classification.
